Placed: `LvlWarlockShock` 01E7CF ×2 · `LvlWarlockShockElfHaughtyM` 081F05 ×1 (voice list `…ElfHaughtyM`) (3 in all). `LvlWarlockShockElfHaughtyM` (`Ansilvund01`) moved here from Uncategorised → *Unfiled Leveled Wrappers* (user, 2026-10-03); it draws 1–36 (no rung 07).

items: Changing a rung template `EncWarlock0{2–7}TemplateStorm` also needs that rung's boss template `EncWarlock0NTemplateBossStorm` (7 · 14 · 21 · 30 · 40 · 50, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as its template but not for `Stats`.

Changing `EncWarlock00Template` 044CCC (the shared base of every rung template, which uses it without `Stats`) also needs `WIChangeLocation04Student` 06F214 (1, left out as not an enemy on the *Warlocks* group page): same pattern.
The Storm rungs are also drawn through `LCharWarlockElemental`: the records that keep their own level beside its wrapper are on *Elemental Mages*.
Every other record here (the rung leaves and every Storm wrapper) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
